mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and hypocalcemia increase risk of risedronate-related esophageal irritation and osteonecrosis of the jaw; loop diuretics also increase fracture risk which counteracts risedronate's therapeutic benefit.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium) regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic or optimize dosing; maintain proper risedronate administration technique (upright position, empty stomach); assess bone mineral density trends.
